changes.comment: Add FileTreeTaskRepository: task records over an injected FileTree root, with one-record atomic commit of state, owed updates and dedup evidence; the ordered inventory registration protocol; open-time validation with a read-only recovery handle; and the derived A3 capacity ledger with persisted claims, admission and explicit limit increase. Durable mode claims process-crash survival only, on FileTree-qualified roots. Revises T1 vocabulary: adds the first-resolution claim purpose and maximumResolutionCharges, lets a reserved claim's charges shrink as they are spent, and fixes update identity as taskUpdateId.
